name: OEDRO Floor Mats Fits for 2014-2018 Chevy Silverado/GMC Sierra 1500 Crew Cab,2015-2019 Silverado/Sierra 2500 HD/3500 HD Crew Cab,Black TPE All Weather 2 Row Floor Liner Set (Front & 2nd Seat)
fitment:
Fits for 2014-2018 Chevy Silverado/GMC Sierra 1500 Crew Cab.
Fits for 2015-2019 Silverado/Sierra 2500 HD/3500 HD Crew Cab.
Key Point: Doesn't fit the Models With Manual 4x4 Shifter On The Floor, Vinyl Flooring, Or e-Assist. The rear Liner Covers Under 2nd Row Seat.

description:
Design to Chevy all-weather floor mats come with a meticulous and effective blueprint to promote a precise fit to your ride, a comfortable ride quality, and all-season drivability. In addition to providing great protection to your carpet against liquids, mud, snow, chemicals, and debris, all-weather floor mats also add a refined look to your vehicle.
Features
Durability. One of the best things about OEDRO floor mats is that they are developed with strong rubber. This gives them longevity in comparison to other styles of mats. Honda floor mats are quite flexible. The heavy-duty material is also capable of withstanding constant rubbing and contacting of shoes.
Excellent Visual Appearance. By adding an all-weather floor liner to your car’s interior, you will add color and class to your car. The mat’s unique appearance will accentuate the interior look of your car tenfold.
TPE Construction. OEDRO floor mats are made of TPE. This material is strong and durable, yet flexible even in extreme cold, as well as non-toxic, fire-resistant, UV-resistant, environmentally friendly, and odorless, so your interior won’t take on an unpleasant smell.
Superior Comfort and Liner Retention. Air pockets created during the injection molding process provide a cushioning and sound-deadening effect for greater driving comfort and the ridges that form the pockets grip the carpet, so the floor mats stay firmly in place.
Easy Clean-Up. When OEDRO floor mats get dirty, just remove them from the vehicle, hose off the muck, allow them to dry, and reinstall.
2 years warranty. For your safety, professional installation is highly recommended.
Fitment
Fits for 2014-2018 Chevy Silverado/GMC Sierra 1500 Crew Cab.
Fits for 2015-2019 Silverado/Sierra 2500 HD/3500 HD Crew Cab.
Key Point: Doesn't fit the Models With Manual 4x4 Shifter On The Floor, Vinyl Flooring, Or e-Assist. The rear Liner Covers Under 2nd Row Seat.
highlights: Premium Interior Protection: OEDRO Floor mats trap dirt, debris, and liquids to keep your vehicle floor clean and protected.
Secure Driving Confidence: Anti-slip texture keeps mats firmly in place, helping ensure a safer and more stable ride.
Built to Last: Durable, recyclable Thermoplastic Elastomer construction delivers long-term protection with easy maintenance.
